# S3 conformance

Every pull request runs the **whole** suite —
[go-faster/s3t](https://github.com/go-faster/s3t), a Go port of
[ceph/s3-tests](https://github.com/ceph/s3-tests) — and fails if any test outside the
known-failures list fails, or if any of the **105** tests inside it passes.
The list can therefore only shrink; a newly passing test shows up on the pull
request that made it pass, rather than waiting to be noticed.

What follows is that list, grouped. Everything else in the suite passes.

## Remaining gaps by feature area

| Feature area | Tests not passing |
|--------------|------------------:|
| Full ACL grammar and bucket-level ?acl | 32 |
| Object Lock, retention and legal hold | 36 |
| SSE-C and SSE-KMS | 15 |
| AWS Signature V2 | 13 |
| Bucket policy engine | 6 |
| Expect header handling | 2 |
| Content-Length ordering | 1 |
| **Total** | **105** |

## SDK & client coverage

Beyond ceph/s3-tests, the server is exercised end-to-end through real S3
clients:

| Client | How |
|--------|-----|
| [minio-go](https://github.com/minio/minio-go) | in-process integration tests (`integration/`) |
| [aws-sdk-go-v2](https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2) | in-process integration tests (`integration/`) |
| aws-cli, MinIO `mc`, `s3cmd`, `rclone` | live-binary smoke matrix (`scripts/cli-smoke.sh`, CI-gated) |

Custom `fs.Storage` backends inherit the behavioral contract via the
[`storagetest`](../storagetest) conformance suite.
